title: Declarations on Pre-packaged Commodities
text: No person shall manufacture, pack, sell, import, distribute, deliver, offer, expose or possess for sale any pre-packaged commodity unless such package is in such standard quantity or number and bears thereon such declarations and information in such manner as may be prescribed.
summary: Mandates that all pre-packaged commodities sold in India must display mandatory statutory declarations.

title: Manufacturer and Packer Name & Address
text: Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer, or in case of imported packages, the name and address of the importer.
summary: Requires full contact name and address of manufacturer, packer, or importer on every package.

title: Generic/Common Name of Commodity
text: Every package shall contain the common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package, clearly displayed on the principal display panel.
summary: Mandates generic or common name of the product to be declared on the main packaging panel.

title: Net Quantity Declaration
text: The net quantity, in terms of standard unit of weight or measure (grams, kilograms, milliliters, liters) or number, shall be declared on every package. Standard units must follow metric standard conventions (g, kg, ml, l, L).
summary: Requires net content weight or volume in standard metric units (g, kg, ml, L).

title: Date of Manufacture / Packing / Import
text: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed or imported shall be given on the package in the format MM/YYYY or Month Year.
summary: Requires month and year of manufacturing, packing, or importing.

title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration
text: The retail sale price of the package shall be clearly stated in Indian Rupees as Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Rs. XX.XX or ₹ XX.XX (inclusive of all taxes). No seller can charge higher than the declared MRP.
summary: Mandates clear display of Maximum Retail Price (MRP) in ₹ inclusive of all taxes.

title: Consumer Care Details
text: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address (if available) of the person who or the office which can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
summary: Mandates customer care contact details including name/office, phone number, and email.

title: Country of Origin Declaration
text: Every package shall bear the name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly on the package where the commodity is imported.
summary: Mandates explicit declaration of Country of Origin for all manufactured and imported commodities.

title: Manner in which Declarations shall be Made
text: All declarations specified under these rules shall be legible, prominent, definite, and plain. The background and color of letters must contrast sharply with the background of the package to ensure high visibility.
summary: Mandates legibility, high color contrast, and clear visibility for all packaging declarations.

title: Minimum Height of Numerals and Letters (Font Size)
text: The minimum height of numerals and letters for net quantity and MRP declarations depends on package size: Net quantity up to 50g/ml requires minimum 1.0mm height (2.0mm for blown/molded); 50g-200g requires 2.0mm (4.0mm blown); 200g-1kg requires 4.0mm; above 1kg requires 6.0mm minimum numeral height.
summary: Prescribes minimum height in millimeters for declaration letters and numerals according to net quantity.

title: Prohibition of Dual MRP and Overcharging
text: No person shall declare different maximum retail prices on an identical pre-packaged commodity. Furthermore, no retailer, distributor, or e-commerce entity shall charge a price higher than the declared Maximum Retail Price (MRP).
summary: Strictly prohibits charging above declared MRP or declaring dual MRPs for identical products.

title: E-Commerce Mandatory Declarations
text: An e-commerce entity shall ensure that the mandatory declarations including Country of Origin, Manufacturer, Net Quantity, Best Before / Expiry date, and MRP are displayed on the digital and electronic network used for e-commerce transactions prior to purchase.
summary: Mandates all statutory label declarations to be visible to consumers on digital marketplaces before purchase.

title: Exemptions for Pre-packaged Commodities
text: Nothing in these rules shall apply to packages containing food articles or commodities of net weight or measure of 10 grams or 10 milliliters or less, packages of commodities meant for fast food items packed by restaurant/hotel, or packages containing agricultural farm produce exceeding 50 kg.
summary: Provides exemptions for tiny packages (<=10g or 10ml) and hotel/restaurant service parcels.

title: Penalty for Selling Non-Standard Packages
text: Whoever manufactures, packs, imports, sells, or distributes any pre-packaged commodity which does not conform to the declarations on the package shall be punished with a fine which may extend to twenty-five thousand rupees, and for second offense up to fifty thousand rupees, and for subsequent offenses with fine up to one lakh rupees or imprisonment up to one year, or both.
summary: Outlines statutory fines up to ₹25,000 for first offense, ₹50,000 for second, and up to ₹1 Lakh / 1 year imprisonment for repeat offenses.

title: Offenses by Companies and Liability of Directors
text: Where an offense under this Act has been committed by a company, the person nominated by the company to be in charge of business, and in the absence of nomination every director and manager, shall be deemed to be guilty of the offense and shall be liable to be proceeded against and punished.
summary: Holds nominated company officials, directors, and managers personally liable for violations of packaged commodity rules.
